title: Identity, composition and cone equations of canonical complex cohomology maps
statement: Let J be a small category, D:J\to Sch a scheme diagram and c a cone. Let K_i be bounded-below complexes of abelian etale sheaves on D_i and psi_f:D(f)^*K_i\to K_j for f:j\to i, satisfying the inverse-image identity and composition comparisons explicitly in lean.statement. Let G:J^op\to Complex(Sh(c.pt)) and eG_i:G_i\simeq c.pi_i^*K_i satisfy the displayed canonical transition equation, and L a cocone of G whose vertex complex is bounded below. Fix p in Z. Set m_f=P_p(D(f),K_i) followed by H^p(Q psi_f), where P_p is rawAffineComplexPullback [def-sbc-raw-affine-restricted-cohomology]. Set b_i=P_p(c.pi_i,K_i) followed by H^p(Q(eG_i.inv followed by L.iota_i)). Then m_id=id, m_(g followed by f)=m_f followed by m_g, and m_f followed by b_j=b_i. No limiting or colimiting universal property is assumed; the bounds are exactly those needed to apply [lem-weil-pbc-derived-cohomology-pullback-laws].

proof.text: Define pairMap(f,K,L,a,p) as rawAffineComplexPullback(p,f,K) followed by H^p(Qa). Expand its definition to verify the formula required by derivedEtaleCohomology_pullback_laws.

Apply the existing public derivedEtaleCohomology_pullback_laws theorem to pairMap and its formula proof. Package the stage complexes and cocone vertex as CochainComplex.Plus using their supplied bounds. Its identity and composition conclusions give pair-map identity and composition. No exact-functor factorization or unit/Leray lemma is proved again.

Transport pairMap across equality of scheme morphisms by substitution. Use hidentity and hcomposition to specialize the preceding laws to m_i. For b_i, precompose the coefficient cocone naturality equation with eG_i.inv and rewrite hG, cancelling eG_i.inv followed by eG_i.hom. Use the pairMap composition equation for D.map f followed by c.pi_j, with c.w identifying the composite with c.pi_i. Substitute the resulting coefficient equality. Only the supplied boundedness is used, through the existing pullback-law theorem; no geometric limit, coefficient colimit or continuity assumption is used.

theorem rawAffineComplex_system_map_coherence {J : Type v} [SmallCategory J]
    (D : J ⥤ Scheme.{v}) (c : Cone D)
    (K : ∀ i : J, CochainComplex (Sheaf (D.obj i).smallEtaleTopology
      AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}) ℤ)
    (hK : ∀ i : J, CochainComplex.plus _ (K i))
    (ψ : ∀ {i j : J} (f : j ⟶ i),
      ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} (D.map f)).mapHomologicalComplex
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj (K i) ⟶ K j)
    (hidentity : ∀ i : J, ψ (𝟙 i) =
      (NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex
        (eqToIso (congrArg (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}) (D.map_id i)))
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).hom.app (K i) ≫
      (NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex (upperStarId AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} (D.obj i))
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).hom.app (K i))
    (hcomposition : ∀ (i j k : J) (f : j ⟶ i) (g : k ⟶ j),
      ψ (g ≫ f) =
        (NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex
          (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} (D.map g) (D.map f)
            (D.map (g ≫ f)) (D.map_comp g f))
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).hom.app (K i) ≫
        ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} (D.map g)).mapHomologicalComplex
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).map (ψ f) ≫ ψ g)
    (G : (J)ᵒᵖ ⥤ CochainComplex (Sheaf c.pt.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}) ℤ)
    (eG : ∀ i : J, G.obj (op i) ≅
      ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} (c.π.app i)).mapHomologicalComplex
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj (K i))
    (hG : ∀ (i j : J) (f : j ⟶ i), G.map f.op =
      (eG i).hom ≫
        (NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex
          (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} (c.π.app j) (D.map f)
            (c.π.app i) (c.w f).symm) (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).hom.app (K i) ≫
        ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} (c.π.app j)).mapHomologicalComplex
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).map (ψ f) ≫ (eG j).inv)
    (L : Cocone G) (hL : CochainComplex.plus _ L.pt) (p : ℤ) :
    let m := fun {i j : J} (f : j ⟶ i) ↦
      rawAffineComplexPullback p (D.map f) (K i) ≫
        (cohomology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} (D.obj j) p).map
          (DerivedCategory.Q.map (ψ f))
    let b := fun i : J ↦
      rawAffineComplexPullback p (c.π.app i) (K i) ≫
        (cohomology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} c.pt p).map
          (DerivedCategory.Q.map ((eG i).inv ≫ L.ι.app (op i)))
    (∀ i : J, m (𝟙 i) = 𝟙 _) ∧
      (∀ (i j k : J) (f : j ⟶ i) (g : k ⟶ j), m (g ≫ f) = m f ≫ m g) ∧
      (∀ (i j : J) (f : j ⟶ i), m f ≫ b j = b i)
